item.description: Ohio State's backcourt has sustained a major blow in the thick of its NCAA Tournament hunt. item.title: Ohio State Falters Down the Stretch Against No. 15 Virginia Despite 28-Point Outing From Bruce Thornton
item.description: Bruce Thornton delivered Ohio State to the doorstep of a massive win for its NCAA Tournament résumé, but the Buckeyes couldn't close. Ohio State's offense flatlined in the final 10 minutes of play, scoring seven points in the game’s final quadrant as the Buckeyes (16-9, 8-6 Big Ten) fell to No. 15 Virginia (22-3, 10-2 ACC), 70-66. item.title: Ohio State Blows 19-Point Lead, Falls to No. 20 Maryland 76-75 for Fourth Loss of Season
item.description: Ohio State women’s basketball lost to Maryland on Sunday despite leading by as many as 19 points in the first half. After a dominant first half against the 20th-ranked Terrapins, Ohio State allowed Maryland to take control of the game in the second half. Still with several chances to win or tie the game in the final seconds, the No. 8 Buckeyes came up short on all of them, falling 76-75 for their first loss of the season against a team not ranked in the top 10.
